text:
The Companion Animal Travel Desk has read your complaint carefully and understands how distressing this situation has been. You reported that your pet’s travel crate was mishandled and that the current support process has not matched the urgency you feel while awaiting answers. We want to address the facts with calm urgency and ensure your next steps are protected.

First, please accept our sincere apologies for the stress and uncertainty this has caused you and Benny. Our team at Aurelia Skyways is committed to keeping companion animals safe and to providing responsive communication when anything goes wrong. When a crate issue occurs, we activate a stepwise review that checks the handling record, the chain-of-custody notes, and the relevant station logs, then reconciles them against the itinerary details. That review is underway, and we will not treat this as a routine delay.

You are also asking for confirmation that nothing has been overlooked and for clear guidance on what we require from you to finalize the file. To keep your claim moving without unnecessary waiting, please provide the written confirmation of the crate’s identification details and any photos or tags you have retained. If you have a receipt for crate acceptance, include it as well. If you contacted station staff on-site, include the names and the time window in plain text so our review team can cross-check the record quickly.

<<FACT F118>>.

We are escalating your case to the senior coordinator for companion animal handling review so that the investigation is prioritized and your status updates are consistent. Priya Silva and Maya Wong may be contacted if their records intersect with your routing; if you prefer otherwise, advise us directly so we can adjust the workflow.

We will send the next update as soon as the reconciliation step completes, and we will keep you informed until resolution is reached. Your companion’s welfare remains our top priority.  

Companion Animal Travel Desk
